target: Experientia Pacti 747

source: Ding-ding.
target: Ding-ding.

source: The object resembling a steam train whizzed past Lumian, its presence nearly obscured by the thick, dark mist.
target: Objectum, quod tramen vaporis simile apparuit, celeriter Luminum praeteriit, eius praesentia paene obtecta a spessa et atra nebula.

source: Yet, Lumian managed to discern some details: both carriages were blue and seemed to be crammed with passengers standing and facing the street, their expressions blurred and their forms lacking clear outlines.
target: Tamen, Luminum aliqua perspicere potuit: utraque carraria caerulea erant et videbantur plene onerata vectore stantibus atque viam intuentes, quorum vultus confusi erant et formae liminibus definitis carentes.

source: This is more than what I had witnessed in Fourth Epoch Trier—it isn’t powered by steam.
target: Hoc est plus quam id quod in Trier Aetate Quarta conspexi—non enim vaporis vi operatur.

source: As these thoughts flashed through his mind, Lumian noticed someone at the other end of the street, hunched over, pulling a black, two-wheeled cart with a canopy.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius fulserunt, Luminum animadvertit aliquem in extremo viae, incurvatum, trahentem carrum nigrum duarum rotarum cum tegmine.

source: A lady sitting in the cart, holding a round fan and dressed in a long skirt, was hidden by the thick mist, which obscured the finer details of her and the puller’s attire.
target: Femina in carro sedeens, ventilatrum rotundum tenens et in longa pallio induta, ab spessa nebula abscondita erat, quae subtiliora vestimenta eius atque trahentis occultebat.

source: Lumian found himself staring as the black cart approached.
target: Luminum se fixedo aspectu reperit dum carrus niger appropinquabat.

source: At that moment, the lady in the cart lifted her fan to her face, turned slowly, and looked back at Lumian.
target: Eo momento, femina in carro ventilatrum ad faciem suam levavit, lente se vertit, et ad Luminum respexit.

source: As if the mist had thinned, Lumian could see the back of the lady’s hand holding the fan: swollen and shiny with dark, bluish patches.
target: Velut nebula tenuata esset, Luminum videre potuit dorsum manus feminae, quae ventilatrum tenebat, tumida et nitida maculis obscuris et caeruleis ornamentata.

source: The puller, with a towel around his neck, stopped, and the lady, who seemed about to step down from the peculiar cart, looked towards Lumian.
target: Tractor, cum linteo circa collum induto, sistit, et femina, quae ex carru peculiario descensurum videbatur, ad Luminum respexit.

source: A wave of fear washed over him, instinctively repelling any contact with the lady.
target: Unda timoris eum pervasit, instinctu omne commercium cum ea evitans.

source: Then, he heard a panicked whisper—it was his own voice, although he harbored no such thoughts!
target: Tum audivit susurrum perterratus—erat vox eius ipsa, quamquam talia cogitationes non fovebat!

source: Standing on the edge of the street, enveloped in the dark mist, Lumian felt a sharp tension as if his true self wasn’t entirely present.
target: Stans in margine viae, in atra nebula involutus, Luminum acutam tensionem sensit, quasi verus ipse non omnino adesset.

source: Lumian’s heart tightened as he attempted to step back.
target: Cor Luminum contraxit, cum conabatur recedere.

source: He suddenly found himself floating up, soaring into midair.
target: Subito se invenit levitare sursum, in medium aërem volitans.

source: He saw the core of the dense mist, a vast city with a bizarre, shadowy high tower beneath which lay unspeakable horrors and gloom.
target: Vidit mediam densae nebulae partem: magnam urbem cum turri altae et insolitae, sub qua inaudita horrores et lugenda tristitia iacebant.

source: Unwillingly, he flew towards it.
target: Invitus ad eam volavit.

source: Almost at the same time, he saw specks of starlight appear.
target: Paene simul, vidit puncta lucis stellarum emergere.

source: Lumian abruptly exited his Cogitative state; the city and tower wrapped in the dark mist, the segmented train, and the lady with the floral fan vanished from his “vision.”
target: Luminum subitaneus ex statu cogitativo exiit; urbs et turris, in atra nebula involutae, tramen segmentatum, et femina cum ventilatro florido, ex visione eius evanuerunt.

source: He opened his eyes to see Madam Magician and Mr. Hanged Man.
target: Oculos aperuit, ut Dominam Magicam atque Dominum Suspenditum videret.

source: “You were a bit off just now, showing signs of losing control, so I had to wake you,” Madam Magician briefly explained.
target: «Modo aliquantulum aberas, signa moderationis amittendi ostendens, itaque te excitare necesse habui,» Domina Magica breviter explicavit.

source: Lumian thanked her, extinguished the enticingly fragrant corpse wax candle, and detailed the scenes and characters he had witnessed during his meditation.
target: Luminum eam gratias egit, candela cerae cadaveris, olentissima et alliciens, exstinxit, atque scaenas et characteres, quos in meditatione perspexerat, enarravit.

source: Madam Magician nodded thoughtfully and remarked, “It’s similar to a pact-making ritual."
target: Domina Magica cogitato animo caput annuit et inquit, «Simile est ritu pacti faciendi.»

source: “This has established a connection between you and some unknown entity, progressively aligning with it.
target: «Hoc coniunxit te cum aliqua entitate ignota, quae paulatim tecum se conciliat.»

source: However, unlike a true pact ritual that is directed towards deities, angels, demons, or evil spirits, your pact seems to be with a city.
target: Tamen, contra vero, non ut verus ritus pacti, qui ad deos, angelos, daemones aut malos spiritus pertinet, pactum tuum cum urbe esse videtur.

source: “If I hadn’t interrupted the process earlier, you might have accessed some higher knowledge or power through this pact experience, though it likely wouldn’t have been something positive.”
target: «Si non processum prius interrumpererim, aliquod altiora scientiam aut potentiam per hanc experientiam pacti adeptus esses, etiamsi probabiliter non aliquid beneficum fuisset.»

source: Lumian, no novice in mysticism, understood the nature and implications of such rituals.
target: Luminum, non novitius in mysteriis, naturam atque implicationes talium rituum intellexit.

source: He pondered and then countered, “So, you’re saying that the city in the fog, closely related to Fourth Epoch Trier and very special, has formed a connection with me through this corpse wax candle, despite the vast distances and the layers of seals between us?”
target: Cogitavit deinde et respondit: «Ergo dicis urbem in nebula, quae Trier Aetate Quarta arcte coniuncta atque valde specialis est, per hanc candela cerae cadaveris mecum coniunctionem instituisse, non obstante ingentibus distantibus et stratis sigillis inter nos?»

source: “Yes, it’s not an illusion,” Madam Magician replied, looking towards the candle encased in a small glass vial with a light yellow and red hue.
target: «Ita, non est illusio,» respondit Domina Magica, intuens candelam in parva ampulla vitrea inclusam, leviter flavescentem et rubescentem.

source: “Besides the corpse oils of the Iron-blooded Knight and Demoness of Despair, this candle likely contains some special materials to which its origins I’m not aware of.
target: «Praeter olea cadaveris Equitis Sanguinis Ferrei et Demonissae Desperationis, haec candela verisimiliter aliquam materiam specialem continet, cujus originem nescio.

source: There are two other locations where it could be more effective, allowing you to see and experience more.
target: Sunt duo alii loci in quibus efficacior esse possit, quae tibi plura videre et experiri sinunt.

source: But those are far too dangerous; you already showed signs of losing control, so I wouldn’t recommend trying it now.”
target: Sed illi nimis periculosi sunt; iam signa moderationis amittendi ostendisti, ideo nunc id experiri non commendo.

source: “The other two locations…” Lumian’s curiosity piqued.
target: «Ceteri duo loci…» Luminum curiositas excitata est.

source: “Is one of them Fourth Epoch Trier?”
target: «Estne unus ex illis Trier Aetate Quarta?»

source: In Fourth Epoch Trier, he could already partially see that misty city.
target: In Trier Aetate Quarta iam partim illam urbem nebulosam videre poterat.

source: Lighting the candle and entering a Cogitative state would surely reveal much more sights and experiences!
target: Candela accensa et in statum cogitativum ingrediens certo plura visa et experientiae patefientur!

source: “Yes,” Madam Magician affirmed Lumian’s guess.
target: «Ita,» Domina Magica coniecturam Luminum affirmavit.

source: “And where is the other place?” Lumian inquired further.
target: «Et ubi est alter locus?» Luminum ulterius inquisivit.

source: Unless the School of Truth’s vortex project could unlock Fourth Epoch Trier’s seals, it would be a long time before he could re-enter that version of Trier.
target: Nisi projectum vortex Scholae Veritatis sigilla Trier Aetate Quarta reserare posset, multum temporis ante reingressionem eius versionis futurum erat.

source: Madam Magician eyed Lumian for a few seconds before simply stating, “Bansy.”
target: Domina Magica Luminum per aliquot momenta intuens, deinde simpliciter dixit: «Bansy.»

source: Bansy… Bansy Harbor?
target: Bansy… Portus Bansy?

source: The harbor that had been destroyed by the Church of Storms due to some corruption, where no one had escaped?
target: Portus, qui a Ecclesia Tempestatum propter corruptionem deleta est, in quo nemo effugit?

source: That was also the former home of Red Angel Medici…
target: Id quoque olim erat domus Redi Angeli Medici…

source: Lumian nodded almost imperceptibly.
target: Luminum paene imperceptibiliter annuit.

source: Considering the Red Angel’s gains in Fourth Epoch Trier and the pathways He took, Lumian had no doubts about the special nature of Bansy Harbor being akin to that of Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: Consideratis lucris Redi Angeli in Trier Aetate Quarta et itineribus quibus egit, Luminum non dubitabat de natura speciali Portus Bansy, quae Trier Aetate Quarta similis esset.

source: “Of course, it must be a specific place in Bansy Harbor, not just anywhere,” Madam Magician added.
target: «Certe, debet esse locus peculiaris in Portu Bansy, non omnino ubicumque,» Domina Magica addidit.

source: Then she continued, “There’s another place I’m not sure about for the candle’s efficacy.”
target: Deinde perrexit: «Alius locus est, de quo quantopere candela efficax sit, certus non sum.»

source: “Which place?” Lumian asked, then had a sudden insight, “City of Exiles, Morora?”
target: «Qui locus?» Luminum rogavit, deinde subito intellexit: «Urbs Exilium, Morora?»

source: “Correct, you’re now clearly seeing the connections between things,” Madam Magician praised him, sternly advising, “If you do decide to venture to those places and use the corpse wax candle to aid your Cogitation and complete the pact, make sure someone is with you at all times to monitor your condition and wake you immediately if anything unusual occurs.”
target: «Recte, nunc manifesta coniunctiones rerum vides,» Domina Magica eum laudavit et severiter admonuit, «si statuas iter illis locis agere et candela cerae cadaveris ad tuam cogitationem adiuvandam atque pactum perficere adhibere, cura ut semper aliquis te comitari possit, ut condicionem tuam perscrutetur atque te statim excitet, si quid insolitum eveniat.»

source: “I’ll remember that,” Lumian promised earnestly.
target: «Id meminero,» Luminum ex animo promisit.

source: As Madam Magician gestured for Lumian to pack away the candle, she thought for a moment and said, “Use the Sword of Courage as a Sealed Artifact for now.
target: Dum Domina Magica Luminum ad candelam recondendam hortabatur, paulisper meditata, dixit: «Utere gladio fortitudinis ut rem sigillatam pro tempore.»

source: “When it’s time to concoct the Iron-blooded Knight potion, I’ll revert it into a Beyonder characteristic.”
target: «Cum tempus ad potionem Equitis Sanguinis Ferreae conficiendam venerit, eam in proprietatem Beyonder revertere curabo.»

source: “By the way, the Sealed Artifact crafted by Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristics should be completed in a few days.”
target: «Praeterea, Artifactum Sigillatum, a proprietatibus Beyonder Hisoka confectum, paucis diebus perficietur.»

source: “Thank you, Madam Magician,” Lumian expressed his gratitude sincerely.
target: «Gratias tibi ago, Domina Magica,» inquit Luminum sincere.

source: Although obtaining the Iron-blooded Knight main ingredient so easily felt somewhat unreal, when he thought about how the Blood Emperor’s residual aura came to be, which played a key role in it, and the issue of the Underworld Daoist’s seal, he realized it wasn’t that “easy” after all.
target: Licet adeptio ingredienti principali Equitis Sanguinis Ferreae tam facile videbatur ut quasi irrealia, cum cogitaret quomodo aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis, quae partes maximas obtinuerat, exsisteret, atque quaestione sigilli Taoistae Inferni, intellexit tamen id non ita facile esse.

source: Lumian then discussed the remains of Omebella’s umbilical cord and Ludwig’s three processing methods, finally asking, “Can I consume that piece of umbilical cord to gain some of the Great Mother’s Child of God’s bloodline?”
target: Deinde Luminum de reliquiis funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae et tribus methodis Ludwigii tractandas disseruit, denique rogans: «Num illud fragmentum funiculi ombilicalis sumere possum ut aliquam partem stirpis sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre adipiscar?»

source: Madam Magician’s expression turned slightly strange as she looked towards The Hanged Man Alger, seemingly seeking his opinion on the matter.
target: Vultus Dominae Magicae paulo insolitus factus est, dum ad Dominum Suspenditum Alger spectabat, quasi eius sententiam de re quaereret.

source: The Hanged Man looked at Lumian and asked seriously, “This will indeed bring you some opportunities, but with them, corresponding risks as well.
target: Dominus Suspenditus Luminum intuebatur et serio quaesivit: «Hoc certe tibi aliquas opportunitates afferet, sed simul pericula congruentes quoque.

source: We can help you, but we can’t be there every moment.
target: Te adiuvare possumus, sed non possumus omni momento adesse.

source: You need to consider whether you’re willing to take this risk and if it’s worth it.”
target: Oportet te deliberare an hoc periculum subire velis et an id pretium habeat.

source: Madam Magician added, “While the Great Mother’s attention might sound nebulous and not tangible enough to have a real effect—after all, you’re already under the scrutiny of the being known as Inevitability—having one more such entity’s attention might not seem like a big deal.
target: Domina Magica addidit, «Etsi attentio Magnae Matris nebulosa videri potest et non satis concreta ad effectum verum facienda, cum iam sub inspectione entitatis, quae “Inevitabilitas” appellatur, sis, alterius huiusmodi attentio non videatur rem magni momenti esse.

source: However, remember, the Great Mother’s interference and permeation in our world far exceed those of the Inevitability entity.
target: Tamen memento, interventio et permeatio Magnae Matris in nostro mundo longe superant illa entitatis Inevitabilitatis.

source: If you do consume Omebella’s umbilical cord remnants, you might face unknown influences or attract special enemies without even realizing it.
target: Si reliquias funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae consumes, fortasse incognitas influentias subire aut hostes speciales attrahere poteris, quin id sentias.

source: “Of course, there’s only a potential risk, not a certainty.”
target: «Certe, solum periculum potentiale est, non certitudo.»

source: What concerned Lumian more was another point.
target: Quod Luminum magis sollicitavit, alterum erat.

source: “Madam Magician, Mr. Hanged Man, it seems you’ve already confirmed that consuming Omebella’s umbilical cord will bring some opportunities?”
target: «Domina Magica, Domine Suspendite, videtur iam confirmavisse vos quod reliquias funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae sumere nonnullas opportunitates afferre possint?»

source: This must be a significantly useful opportunity; otherwise, Madam Magician’s expression wouldn’t have become strange, nor would she have consulted Mr. Hanged Man.
target: Hoc certe occasionem utilissimam esse debet; alioquin vultus Dominae Magicae non fuisset insolitus neque Dominum Suspenditum consuluisset.

source: There’s no need to hesitate on matters with only downsides; it’s the presence of significant potential benefits that causes Madam Magician to pause!
target: Non est opus haesitare de rebus quae solum incommoda habent; sed praesentia commodorum potentialium maximi efficit ut Domina Magica pauseat!

source: Madam Magician weighed her words carefully before responding, “The vortex project might involve a location tainted by the Great Mother’s power, teeming with monsters spawned from this corruption.
target: Domina Magica verba sua caute ponderavit antequam respondit: «Projectum vortex includere potest locum, ab potentia Magnae Matris contaminatum, monstris ex hac corruptione generatis plenum.

source: If you possess the bloodline of the Great Mother’s Child of God, theoretically, you wouldn’t need to worry about attacks from them, and you might even be able to command them simply.
target: Si stirpem sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre possides, theoretice de eorum impetibus non solliciti eris, atque fortasse eos simpliciter imperare poteris.

source: That’s one aspect.
target: Hoc est unum aspectus.

source: Another is that once you meet two other prerequisite conditions, you should be able to touch and briefly use a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.”
target: Alterum est quod, cum duas alias conditiones praerequiras impleveris, tangeri atque breviter uti Artifacto Sigillato Gradus 0 poteris.

source: Grade 0 Sealed Artifact… Extremely Dangerous.
target: Artifactum Sigillatum Gradus 0… valde periculosum.

source: Not to be inquired, disseminated, described, or spied; capable of destroying a country or even the whole world… Lumian’s spirit lifted at the mention.
target: Non ad quaerendum, divulgandum, describendum, neque inspiciendum destinatum; id habet potentiam terram aut totum orbem delere… Spiritus Luminum in hac mentione elevatus est.

source: So far, he had indirectly encountered two Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts: 0-01 and 0-05.
target: Usque ad hoc, duos Artifactos Sigillatos Gradus 0 — 0-01 et 0-05 — indirecte occurrerat.

source: “What’s the number of that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact?” Lumian curiously asked.
target: «Quod est numerus illius Artifacti Sigillati Gradus 0?» inquit Luminum curiosus.

source: “Why would having the Great Mother’s Child of God bloodline allow me to touch and briefly use it?”
target: «Cur possessio stirpis sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre mihi permittit eam tangere atque brevi tempore uti?»

source: Madam Magician glanced at Lumian and said, “I can’t tell you the details yet.
target: Domina Magica Luminum aspiciens inquit: «Nondum tibi singularia exponere possum.

source: All I can say is, it’s not the Child of God bloodline of the Great Mother that allows you to touch it, but rather the integration of Omebella’s umbilical cord remnants with you that helps you access it without facing severe danger, because it originated from Omebella’s remains.”
target: Singillatim dicere possum: non stirpes sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre te facit eam tangere, sed potius integratio reliquiarum funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae cum te adiuvat, ut eam intueri possis sine magno periculo, quoniam ex reliquiis Omebellae orta est.

source: Omebella’s remains… Omebella had remains before being born?
target: Reliquiae Omebellae… Omebella ante ortum reliquias habebat?

source: No, that’s normal, as there are already remnants of the umbilical cord before She was born…
target: Non, hoc normale est, quia iam ante nativitatem eius reliquiae funiculi ombilicalis exstiterunt…

source: Ah, the one that shares the same name?
target: Ah, ille qui eundem nomen habet?

source: No, obviously, it’s more than just sharing names…
target: Non, manifesta quidem, plus est quam solum nomen communicare.

source: Lumian pondered and then asked, “Are you referring to the remnants of the Goddess of Harvest from ancient times?”
target: Lumian meditatus deinde rogavit: «Referisne ad reliquias Deae Messis ex temporibus antiquis?»

source: times?
target: Tempora?
